description: This file defines the ChartScrollControl class, which provides a GUI component for navigating through chart pages in a chart repository. It includes navigation buttons, keyboard shortcuts, and callbacks to update the displayed chart.

classes.name: ChartScrollControl
classes.description: A Swing GUI component enabling users to scroll through charts with buttons and keyboard shortcuts, interacting with a chart repository and a listener.

methods.name: ChartScrollControl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the control with a listener, setting up UI components and key bindings.

methods.name: previousPage
methods.description: Navigates to the previous chart page, wrapping around if necessary.

methods.name: showChart
methods.description: Displays the chart at the current index and notifies the listener.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Navigates to the next chart page.

methods.name: bindKeyStrokeActions
methods.description: Sets up keyboard shortcuts for navigating charts.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the main JPanel containing the control UI.

methods.name: setInfoText
methods.description: Updates the label with the current index and total size.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets navigation index to zero and updates display.
